chapterTitle: Chapter 4 Organic Compounds: Cycloalkanes and Their Stereochemistry
title: Problem 4-10

pages.text: PROBLEM 4-10 How many H ⟷ H eclipsing interactions would be present if cyclopentane were planar? Assuming an energy cost of 4.0 kJ/mol for each eclipsing interaction, how much torsional strain would planar cyclopentane have? Since the measured total strain of cyclopentane is 26 kJ/mol, how much of the torsional strain is relieved by puckering?
